# sin: the temple stands
jip_sabian_site_temple_sin = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		title:b_harran.title_province = { has_building = jip_temple_of_sin_01 }
	}
}

# sin: the statue is home
jip_sabian_site_home_sin = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = jip_old_gods_home target = flag:sin }
	}
}

# sin: the temple's barony is in the owner's realm
jip_sabian_site_held_sin = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		title:b_harran.holder ?= { target_is_same_character_or_above = root }
	}
}
